\chapter{General Provisions}
\label{\detokenize{section1_general:general-provisions}}\label{\detokenize{section1_general::doc}}\begin{enumerate}
\sphinxsetlistlabels{\arabic}{enumi}{enumii}{}{.}%
\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
The scope of application of this technical specification is limited to the supply, installation, commissioning, and corresponding services of Diesel generator equipment.

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
This technical requirements document specifies minimum requirements and does not prescribe all details, nor does it fully cite the provisions of relevant standards and specifications. Bidders shall ensure that products provided comply with this technical requirements document and relevant latest standards, and that the engineering installation quality meets design requirements, this technical requirements document, and the latest applicable American codes and standards.

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
If standards used in this technical requirements document conflict with standards executed by the bidder, the higher standard shall apply.

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Bidders shall provide clear responses to all functional, performance, and usage requirements listed in this technical requirements document. If the functions or technical performance indicators of the bid products exceed the requirements of this technical requirements document, such shall be clearly explained in the bid documents to facilitate a favorable evaluation of the bidder in cases where the evaluated prices are equal or equivalent.

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Items marked with ★: Non\sphinxhyphen{}deviable clauses in this document.

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Items marked with ▲: Important clauses in this document.

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Equipment and materials selected by bidders in their bids shall meet or exceed the requirements of this technical requirements document. Unless otherwise specified, all specified technical parameters or parameter ranges in this technical requirements document shall be understood as minimum requirements acceptable to the tenderer. That is, when the corresponding technical parameter or parameter range is better when smaller, the specified technical parameter or parameter range shall be understood as the upper limit or maximum allowable range; when the corresponding technical parameter or parameter range is better when larger, the specified technical parameter or parameter range shall be understood as the lower limit or minimum allowable range.

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Equipment shall be supplied as a complete set, assembled as a whole by the same manufacturer, and OEM production is not accepted. The unit shall be completely assembled by the manufacturer and transported intact to the site.

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
All information provided by the Bidder shall be in Chinese. The Bidder shall be responsible for any losses caused by language errors. All products inside and outside the Diesel generator container shall have English labels and LOGO; no Chinese labels shall be used.

\end{enumerate}

\section{Dummy section title}
\label{\detokenize{section2_requirements:dummy-section-title}}\begin{itemize}
\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Equipment provided by the bidder shall meet the requirements of the bidding documents, including detailed requirements not fully described in the bidding documents but necessary to ensure normal and effective operation of the equipment, and shall provide new, advanced, and high\sphinxhyphen{}quality equipment.

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
The bidder shall be responsible for patents involved in the bid content and shall protect the tenderer's interests from any infringement. All legal rulings, litigation, and expenses arising from text, trademark, and technical patent infringement shall have no relation to the tenderer.

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Markings: Each equipment shall have a nameplate, and the content of the nameplate shall be determined according to relevant standards of the United States of America.

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Delivery time: After the contract is signed, Party B shall transport the equipment to the domestic port designated by Party A (tentatively Shanghai Port) within the agreed time after receiving Party A's delivery notice.

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
The bidder shall provide a detailed after\sphinxhyphen{}sales service plan in the bid documents, which includes but is not limited to the following: Installation guidance and commissioning responsibility: Tentatively, the requesting party sends personnel to the factory for training, and the requesting party completes it. Trial operation and handover for use: Tentatively, the requesting party sends personnel to the factory for training, and the requesting party completes it.

\end{itemize}


\section{Dummy section title}
\label{\detokenize{section2_requirements:id1}}\begin{itemize}
\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
The software and hardware products of diesel generator sets provided by the bidder must be mature products (the products provided must be mature products with more than 5 years of history), and provide more than 2 commercial cases of similar scale that have been successfully implemented and operated in the past 3 years.

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
When the bidder or equipment manufacturer designs, manufactures, assembles, inspects, and commissions the equipment and materials required by this document, the local climate conditions of Royse City, Texas, USA shall be considered. The bidder shall ensure that the supplied equipment and materials operate reliably under local climate conditions.

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
★ \sphinxstylestrong{The Bidder shall provide certificates from an authoritative US testing institution}: the container shelter as a whole shall have UL2755 certification (Prefabricated Modular Data Center), and the container generator set shall have UL2200 certification and test report. The main content of the certificates and test reports shall be consistent with the bidding products and manufacturer. The emissions shall meet EPA\sphinxhyphen{}Tier2 or EPA\sphinxhyphen{}Tier4 standard after strict SCR device catalytic reduction treatment. This project tentatively does not consider space heaters and other measures for extreme cold weather conditions; design is based on conventional temperatures of \sphinxhyphen{}10°C to +49°C.

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
The bidder shall provide certificates and test reports issued by authoritative American testing institutions. The main content of the certificates and test reports shall be consistent with the bid products and manufacturer.

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
★ \sphinxstylestrong{All products provided by the Bidder must have legal usage rights within the United States.}

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
★ \sphinxstylestrong{The Bidder shall ensure that all hardware equipment are original manufacturer products, not OEM products.}

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
The bidder must ensure that the configured software products have legitimate usage rights and corresponding usage licenses.

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
The successful bidder shall provide detailed design for diesel generator installation, intake and exhaust ventilation, smoke exhaust, oil pipelines, oil tanks, and oil pipeline control.

\end{itemize}
